issues.t: Air bag sensing module may fail (recall 07V-062)
issues.sym: An airbag warning light, or no warning at all.
issues.why: The airbag sensing module may fail, so the front airbags may not deploy in a crash.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it fixed promptly.

issues.t: Wiper linkage may come off the motor (recall 08V-410)
issues.sym: Wipers stop moving even though the motor can be heard running.
issues.why: The wiper linkage may separate from the motor shaft, leaving the wipers dead.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it done before driving in rain or snow.

issues.t: Lost 3rd, 5th and reverse gears (GM special coverage 14404B)
issues.sym: No reverse, gears skipped while accelerating, or a transmission warning light.
issues.why: A wave plate inside the 3-5-reverse clutch of the six-speed automatic can crack and break apart. GM's extended coverage for it has expired.
issues.next: Have a transmission shop diagnose it and use the updated wave plate. Avoid driving with severe slipping, since it can strand you.

issues.t: Heated windshield washer module can overheat and catch fire (recalls 08V-441, 10V-240)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from under the hood, or the heated washer feature not working.
issues.why: A circuit board in the heated washer fluid system can short and overheat, which can start a fire under the hood.
issues.next: Check the VIN for these recalls. Until it is fixed, park outside and away from buildings.

issues.t: Power liftgate struts wear and the gate can drop (recall 15V-415)
issues.sym: The liftgate drifts down, will not stay open, or the power motor strains.
issues.why: The liftgate gas struts can wear out early, so an open liftgate may fall on someone.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and keep clear of an open liftgate until it is fixed.

issues.t: Timing chain stretch (GM bulletin 12-06-01-009A)
issues.sym: Check-engine light with cam and crank timing codes, a rattle at cold start, rough idle or weak power.
issues.why: The timing chains and guides on the 3.6L V6 wear and stretch over time, faster with long oil change intervals. GM issued bulletins with updated parts.
issues.next: Get timing codes checked promptly, since a badly stretched chain can jump and damage the engine. Change the oil on time with GM-approved oil.

issues.t: A/C evaporator leaks
issues.sym: Warm air from the vents, A/C that goes from cold to warm, or the rear A/C quitting first.
issues.why: The front and especially the rear A/C evaporators on these three-row GM crossovers are known to leak refrigerant, and repeat rear evaporator failures are common.
issues.next: Have the system leak-tested with dye or a sniffer instead of just recharged, since a recharge usually lasts only a short time.

issues.t: Water leak from the sunroof into the headliner (GM bulletin 10-08-67-001C)
issues.sym: A wet or stained headliner, water dripping near the front or rear sunroof glass, or damp carpets.
issues.why: Water can get past the sunroof glass or its drains. GM issued a bulletin with diagnosis and repair steps.
issues.next: Have the sunroof drains and seals checked soon. Standing water can damage wiring and cause mold.

issues.t: Service Air Bag warning from seat wiring (recall 14V-118)
issues.sym: A Service Air Bag message or airbag light, sometimes only when the seats are moved.
issues.why: Side airbag wiring under the front seats can develop high resistance, which can keep the side airbags and belt pretensioners from working in a crash.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get the free repair.

issues.t: Shift cable clip may not be fully seated (recall 09V-073)
issues.sym: The shifter position may not match the gear, and the vehicle may roll even with the lever in Park.
issues.why: A shift cable clip may not be fully engaged, so the transmission may not be in the gear the lever shows.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Second-row trim can block the seat belt buckle (recall 10V-375)
issues.sym: A second-row seat belt that is hard to latch or does not latch fully.
issues.why: A trim shield on the second-row seat can interfere with the buckle so the belt may not latch.
issues.next: Make sure the belt clicks fully and check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Front seat belt cable can break (recall 14V-266)
issues.sym: Usually no warning sign; the belt may feel loose at the buckle end.
issues.why: The steel cable that holds the front seat belt buckle can wear and separate over time, so the belt may not hold in a crash.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it done promptly.

issues.t: Wiper arm can loosen from snow and ice (recall 12V-151)
issues.sym: Wipers that slip or stop clearing the windshield in snow or ice.
issues.why: Heavy snow or ice on the wipers can loosen the wiper arm from its pivot.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall, mainly if you live in a cold-weather state.

issues.t: Side curtain airbags may not be attached properly (recall 21V-246)
issues.sym: Usually no warning sign.
issues.why: The side curtain airbags may not be secured correctly, so they may not protect occupants as designed in a crash.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it fixed promptly.

issues.t: Shift cable adjuster may come off the lever (recall 14V-092)
issues.sym: The shifter feels disconnected or the gear shown does not match the actual gear; the vehicle may roll in Park.
issues.why: The shift cable adjuster can disengage from the shift lever.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Fuel gauge may read wrong (recall 14V-223)
issues.sym: The fuel gauge shows more fuel than is in the tank, and the vehicle may run out of fuel unexpectedly.
issues.why: Engine control software can misreport the fuel level.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and refuel early until the software is updated.

issues.t: Driver airbag inflator may rupture (recalls 23V-334, 22V-246)
issues.sym: No warning before a crash.
issues.why: The driver airbag inflator may rupture when it deploys and throw metal fragments into the cabin.
issues.next: Check the VIN for these recalls and get the repair as soon as parts are available.

issues.t: Windshield wiper motor can overheat (recall 15V-609)
issues.sym: Wipers that stop working, often after heavy use.
issues.why: The wiper motor may overheat and stop working.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it done before driving in bad weather.

issues.t: Third-row seat frame welds may be misplaced (recall 15V-833)
issues.sym: A third-row seat that feels loose or does not hold firmly.
issues.why: Welds on the left third-row lower seat frame may be in the wrong place, so the seat may not hold in a crash.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it repaired.

issues.t: Front brake caliper seal may be damaged (recall 16V-802)
issues.sym: A soft or sinking brake pedal, brake fluid near a front wheel, or a brake warning light.
issues.why: A front caliper piston seal may be torn or out of place, which can leak brake fluid and lengthen stopping distances.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. Do not drive if the brake pedal feels soft or the brake light is on.

issues.t: Front driveshaft can break (recall 17V-516)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of power to the wheels with the engine still running, or a clunk or vibration from the front right.
issues.why: The right front intermediate driveshaft can fracture. If that happens while parked without the parking brake, the vehicle could roll away.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and always set the parking brake until it is repaired.

issues.t: High-pressure fuel pump may come loose (recall 18V-358)
issues.sym: A fuel smell from the engine bay, stalling, or a check-engine light.
issues.why: The high-pressure fuel pump may detach and damage the fuel line, which can leak fuel and create a fire risk.
issues.next: Stop driving if you smell fuel and check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Shift to Park message when already in Park (GM bulletin 19-NA-206)
issues.sym: A Shift to Park warning with the shifter in Park, the vehicle not fully powering down or locking, and a drained battery.
issues.why: The Park switch in the shifter does not always signal the body computer. GM issued a bulletin with a wiring harness jumper repair.
issues.next: Ask a GMC dealer about bulletin 19-NA-206 to prevent dead batteries.

issues.t: Start/stop accumulator end cap may be missing bolts (recall 20V-668)
issues.sym: Transmission fluid leaking, shifting problems, or a loss of drive.
issues.why: The end cap on the transmission's start/stop accumulator may have been installed without all of its bolts, so it can leak fluid.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. Stop driving if you see fluid leaking or the vehicle loses drive.

issues.t: Roof-rail airbag inflator part may separate (recall 20V-446)
issues.sym: Usually no warning sign.
issues.why: A diffuser in the roof-rail airbag inflator may separate when the airbag deploys and could injure occupants.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it done promptly.

issues.t: Backup camera image may fail (recall 22V-709)
issues.sym: A blank, flickering or missing rearview camera image.
issues.why: Connectors on the camera cable may have been crimped poorly at the factory.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and back up using mirrors with extra care until fixed.

issues.t: Fuel supply lines may not be attached properly (recall 21V-422)
issues.sym: A fuel smell or fuel dripping under the vehicle.
issues.why: Fuel supply lines may have been attached incorrectly and can leak, creating a fire risk.
issues.next: Stop driving if you smell fuel and check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Airbag module may have been left inactive (recall 21V-702)
issues.sym: An airbag warning light may stay on.
issues.why: The airbag sensing module may not have been activated at the factory, so airbags may not deploy in a crash.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it done before regular driving.

issues.t: Rear toe link may not be tightened (recall 22V-427)
issues.sym: Clunking from the rear, wandering steering, or uneven rear tire wear.
issues.why: A rear toe link fastener may not have been tightened correctly, so the link could separate and affect steering control.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have it repaired before regular driving.

issues.t: Fuel tank rollover valve may not seal (recall 22V-446)
issues.sym: Usually no warning sign.
issues.why: A rollover valve may not seal, so fuel could leak if the vehicle rolls over.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it fixed.

issues.t: Front half-shaft may disconnect (recalls 23V-043, 23V-172)
issues.sym: A clunk from the front, then a sudden loss of drive while the engine keeps running, or rolling in Park.
issues.why: A right-front half-shaft may not be connected properly, or an incorrect sun gear may let a half-shaft disengage.
issues.next: Check the VIN for these recalls and set the parking brake every time you park until repaired.

issues.t: Windshield may not be bonded properly (recall 23V-681)
issues.sym: Usually no warning; possible wind noise or water leaks around the windshield.
issues.why: The windshield may lack proper bonding sealant, so it may not stay in place in a crash.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it repaired promptly.

issues.t: Stalling after remote start or in cold weather (GM PIP6102)
issues.sym: The engine stalls after a remote start or when shifting into Drive or Reverse during a cold warm-up, then restarts normally.
issues.why: GM opened an investigation into stalling on its 2.5L turbo crossovers. A cause and fix had not been announced when this was written.
issues.next: Report every stall to a GMC dealer so it is documented, and check for new bulletins or recalls. Be careful pulling into traffic on cold mornings.

issues.t: Front seat back welds may be weak (recall 26V-696)
issues.sym: A front seat back that feels loose or shifts when you lean on it.
issues.why: Welds where the seat recliner pivot attaches to the seat frame may be insufficient, so the seat may not hold in a crash.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it repaired promptly.

issues.t: Shudder or vibration from the automatic transmission
issues.sym: A rumble-strip style vibration at steady speeds under light throttle, sometimes with a harsh or delayed shift, and no warning light.
issues.why: The torque converter clutch inside the automatic can judder instead of locking up smoothly, which owners feel through the floor and seat. GM issued a bulletin for the complaint.
issues.next: Ask a GMC dealer about bulletin 18-NA-358 and have the transmission fluid and torque converter checked before the shudder damages the converter.
